key.name: copy-on-select-mode
key.summary: Where selecting text also copies it
key.description: off: never. allowlist: only in the applications in app-list. blocklist: everywhere except the applications in app-list. all: everywhere.

key.name: app-list
key.description: Desktop file IDs such as org.gnome.Terminal.desktop, or window classes. Both are compared with the focused window, ignoring case.

key.name: unify-mode
key.summary: How middle-click paste follows the clipboard
key.description: off: middle-click pastes the last selection, as usual. mirror: every copy is also pasted by middle-click, until you select text somewhere else. strict: middle-click always pastes the last copy, and selections outside the listed applications are undone right away.

key.name: enable-middle-click-paste
key.description: Controls gtk-enable-primary-paste in org.gnome.desktop.interface. When the extension turns it off, it turns it back on when disabled.

key.name: restore-middle-click-paste
key.summary: Middle-click paste was turned off by this extension
key.description: Internal. Set when this extension turned middle-click paste off, so it can turn it back on when disabled.

key.name: min-selection-length
key.summary: Minimum length of a selection to copy

key.name: ignore-whitespace-only
key.summary: Ignore selections that are only whitespace
